business_model: Unknown; likely B2B software for providers (not stated in sources)

technical_complexity.rationale: Automating medical coding and billing needed NLP over clinical documents and payer rules in 2017, difficult for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: No source shows proprietary data, integrations or customers; the idea was open to better funded entrants.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Apixio launched an AI compliance auditor in July 2017 (adjacent, for health plans). No source shows what happened to Semantix itself.

market_need_then: Medical billing complexity is a long standing cost for providers, but no dated 2017 source about this company's demand was found.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found. The name collides with a large unrelated Brazilian public company Semantix, which dominates search.

outcome_analysis: Semantix was a two person YC Summer 2017 company applying AI to medical billing, now listed Inactive by YC. No post-mortem, acquisition, funding announcement or press coverage was found; search results were dominated by an unrelated Brazilian company of the same name. The cause of inactivity is not public, so failure factors are left empty.
notes: No company website is listed and none was found. No funding found in two searches (funding search plus cross-check via aggregator pages). Apixio is recorded in takeover risk but not as a competitor because it audited for health plans, not provider billing. Founder names follow the YC page; some search summaries wrote the surname differently. Exit unknown although YC status is Inactive.
